name: Crescendo Sonore
description: Vibrato soignant les blessures des alliés proches par des fréquences sonores apaisantes accélérant la guérison naturelle.

subject.archetype: Crescendo Sonore — Chœur Synthétique Common class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Crystalline armor plates growing naturally from body vibrating at resonant frequencies with visible sound waves emanating from every surface, each facet catching and fracturing light into rainbows, organic-metal hybrid construction
loadout.arsenal: Resonance tuning fork weapon humming at visible destructive frequency with air distortion around it, harmonic shield gauntlet generating visible ring-shaped sound wave barriers, crystalline conductor baton emitting visible vibration patterns The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting opposite_side, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat medic rushing into the line of fire with healing equipment deployed, dodging projectiles while reaching wounded. Both hands thrust forward in powerful push with focused targeted dimensional pressure field expanding from palms creating visible wall of force pushing against entire opposing side
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Violet Crystal
palette_names.role: primary_accent — resonance energy beams and crystal shards

palette_names.name: Silver Prismatic
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — sound wave visualization and reflections

palette_names.name: Deep Indigo
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — shockwave shadows and deep resonance tones

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield with crystal formations exploding from harmonic overload sending shards every direction, visible shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating cracked ceiling structures, entire environment vibrating at a frequency that makes air appear to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Massive force visible through environmental disruption — air rippling like heat haze, ground buckling and cracking, everything on opposite side being physically pushed backward and compressed, Opposing terrain visibly compressed and pushed backward, barriers and structures cracking from extreme pressure, objects sliding away creating clear zone of force, Visible concentric sound waves expanding outward shattering nearby crystal structures into cascading shards, crystal fragments flying through air catching prismatic light, air visibly rippling and bending from sonic force, ground fracturing in geometric patterns from bass, floating debris suspended in harmonic stasis field
